_note: Media model registry (fal.ai). Endpoints and list prices were checked against fal's live model pages on 2026-11-25 (verified_on). 'image_field' is the model's name for the start/reference image: fal_run.py maps a generic image_url/image_urls onto it. 'defaults' are applied when the caller doesn't set them (e.g. audio OFF, because several models default to audio ON at a higher price). Entries with verify:true still have unconfirmed input names: check https://fal.ai/api/openapi/queue/openapi.json?endpoint_id=<endpoint> before relying on them. The gateway setting `model_registry` overrides this file when present; the self-improver re-checks weekly (model-scouting).

budget_i2v.use: cheap b-roll, drafts, lifestyle scene motion (768p)

standard_i2v.use: default product b-roll and hook shots

hero_i2v.use: hero/hook shot where product fidelity and motion quality matter most
hero_i2v.notes: duration '3'-'15' (string); generate_audio defaults TRUE on fal, so keep the default here false; aspect comes from the start image

premium_i2v.use: premium hero shots when standard models fail fidelity (720p)
premium_i2v.notes: page shows a Private badge: access may be restricted; 1080p $0.235/s

native_audio.use: scenes needing synchronized ambient sound or speech (720p)

open_weights.use: fallback when other models refuse or are down (720p)

presenter.use: AI presenter / talking-head explainer (never a fake customer)
presenter.notes: inputs: prompt (script), avatar, voice; returns video.url and caption_file

product_edit.use: reference-faithful product edits: new background, hands, context

hero.use: hero image when product_edit fails fidelity

remove_bg.use: product cutouts for motion graphics and statics
remove_bg.notes: page price unclear; estimate kept conservative

tts.notes: voice field name not visible on the page

transcribe.notes: returns words[]; start/end fields not shown in the page sample (voiceover.py falls back to even spacing if absent)

music.use: original background music (check vendor commercial terms)

deprecated.status: shut down 2026-09-24 per OpenAI deprecation notice
